notes: Climb traces use shared server movement, production serialization/parser/interpolator and client placement at 60 Hz; they are not a networked gameplay capture.
Finite swimmer probes demonstrate the sampled center/bow/stern/beam clearance contract, not exact collision for every point of the animated hull.
Placement timing is isolated CPU work over fixed populations, not FPS. Managed filtered caches are warmed; order alternates over nine trials of 180 frames.
A probe exactly on a contour can differ within existing field/GPU quantization; the coordinate change preserves shared field arithmetic.
